summary: Two Front Range snowmobilers stranded overnight (Friday) in a meadow NE of the Rabbit Ears rock formation, Rabbit Ears Pass; called 911. Unprepared: no food, water, or light; started a fire with snowmobile gasoline (hard to keep going in the woodless meadow); overnight low 17F. Jackson County SAR led the search; Routt County SAR (IC Kristia Check-Hill) joined at 5 a.m. Saturday; Jackson County team reached the pair ~7:30 a.m. Saturday. Rescued fine, uninjured.
location: Meadow northeast of the Rabbit Ears rock formation, Rabbit Ears Pass
responding_agency: Jackson County Search and Rescue; Routt County Search and Rescue
